answer: New identities start at zero and cannot inherit history, so a sybil cluster must independently fund and sustain every fake account across multiple epochs. Each agent must stake collateral and grow a reputation vine from verified peer attestations, trained along a trellis of prior epoch work. A shared terrace of bonded peers then slashes any identity caught vouching for duplicates, making mass fabrication costlier than legitimate participation. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
